changes.after: Reduced ninth P2CG1 successor after the S3 split: binds all five creators in one change (CF9), consuming G2A identity-only invite resolution before direct guest socket construction. Bind expectedCampaignId to actual campaign identity at CampaignCoopEntryPanel direct connectCampaignSyncTransport, both connected-surface connectStoredCampaignSyncTransport calls and both launch-page creators; use campaignId != matchId in runtime proof. Reject missing/invalid identity or foreign snapshots before adoption and never fetch raw match metadata. New src/lib/campaign/coop/campaignSyncTransportSeat.ts owns seat identity checks (matchId/campaignId/playerId/role), A-to-B detach/attach and snapshot waiting with one fixed timeout, abort/disposal and post-await active-seat verification.
